description: Check RDAP registry record status: registered, not_found, or unknown when coverage is absent. available is false for a found record and null otherwise; a registry miss never guarantees registration eligibility. Known ICANN subdomains are rejected with their registrable parent; private suffixes are not registration boundaries. For the full record use whois_lookup_domain.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to check (e.g., "myfuturename.com"). Must be a valid FQDN — labels separated by dots.

name: whois_check_availability

available.description: False when a registration record exists; otherwise null. A registry miss never establishes availability.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rdap_invalid_domain_response`: The primary RDAP response is not a matching successful domain object. `non_registrable_domain`: An ICANN-recognized suffix identifies the query as a subdomain. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

rdap_coverage.description: True when a RDAP server was found for this TLD.

registration_status.description: Registry record present, absent, or RDAP coverage unavailable; never registration eligibility.

title: Domain Registration Status
